case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised friendly, attentive staff, the calm surroundings, comfortable rooms, a pleasant pool area, and good cleanliness and parking. Several reviewers praised breakfast, though a few mentioned limited variety or that espresso required extra payment. Some guests reported issues including outdated facilities (e.g., shower), firm/high pillows, the absence of an outdoor pool or sunbeds, and single reports about outdoor gym location and paid use of pool table/swim cap.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.recommendation: Conduct a room-condition audit to identify visible outdated items for targeted refreshes.
Add an espresso option included with the standard breakfast or offer a complimentary short espresso.
